description: A QR code for a text of up to 300 characters (a URL, Wi-Fi login or contact card), generated locally. format=svg returns the image itself as image/svg+xml; format=json returns the version, the module count, the SVG and a data URI. Error correction L, M, Q or H (default M); size from 128 to 1024 pixels (default 512). Price: $0.001 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
